observations: The Alaska Division of Elections 2024 General All Details page links the official Summary PDF, ENRbyPrecinct.csv, Combined Ballot Count Report, CVR export ZIP, House District Statements of Votes Cast PDFs HD1.pdf through HD40.pdf plus HD99.pdf, and ranked-choice reports including RCV-USRep.pdf.
The official ENRbyPrecinct.csv was downloaded and retained at data/ak-2024-general-enr-by-precinct.csv.
The ENR precinct CSV contains U.S. President / Vice President and U.S. Representative rows at the same precinct/reporting-unit grain.
Normalized review rows reconcile exactly to the certified statewide presidential totals: 338,177 total votes, 184,458 Trump, 140,026 Harris, and 13,693 Other.

U.S. House named-candidate first-choice rows reconcile to 156,245 DEM votes and 159,550 REP votes, but comparison_other is 13,010 because the ENR precinct CSV does not itemize 750 statewide U.S. House write-in votes included in the summary PDF.
Direct directory listing is no longer needed for this blocker because the All Details page exposes concrete official artifact URLs.
caveats: Do not treat the 523 review rows as precinct polygons; they include absentee, early, question, remote, and HD99-style reporting units.
Alaska U.S. Representative used ranked-choice voting in 2024, so these rows are first-choice named-candidate review rows only.

The official ENR precinct CSV does not itemize U.S. House write-ins by precinct/reporting unit. Request write-in allocation or source confirmation before representing comparison_other as write-in-complete.
